Violates edict 5 (per-instance override of a producer root), edict 4 (mark species composed in demo/ not glass-ui) and edict 3 (the ratified primitive is the KISS answer).
defects.mechanism: design-system boundary breach — a producer species composed at the consumer, so it cannot be reused, suppressed, or governed independently of its host plate
defects.reproduction: Read EmptyState.vue:39-48 against VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:186.
defects.proposedCure: Build `EmptyPaletteMark` in glass-ui: one primitive, one authored size with internally-proportioned satellites, direction-invariant internals, a scale-invariant stroke, one `forced-color-adjust` decision, `aria-hidden` once. This single move also closes D-3, D-5, D-8, D-18, D-20 and answers N-6/N-7.

defects.defect: One flat `gap-2.5` serves four semantic ranks, so the rendered ink rhythm is ragged and there is no title-gap / section-gap distinction at all.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:16,28 apply `gap-2.5` (measured row-gap 10px) between every sibling. Measured line boxes: eyebrow 14.384/21.576, headline 25.888/35.596, hint 16.40/22.96 → half-leadings 3.596 / 4.854 / 3.280. Rendered ink gaps: mark→eyebrow 13.60px, eyebrow→headline 18.45px, headline→hint 18.13px. The decoration is bound 26% more tightly to the label than the label is to the statement, and the two most distinct joints get indistinguishable intervals. Law: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:68 §5.3 "Header→headline uses title gap; headline→next semantic section uses section gap"; :73 §5.8 "Real rendered relation wins over token intent."
defects.mechanism: a single spacing token applied across elements with different line-heights yields three different rendered intervals — flat authored rhythm, ragged rendered rhythm
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/palettes; measure the four children's getBoundingClientRect y/height and computed font-size/line-height.
defects.proposedCure: Two named gaps from the glass-ui ladder: title gap (label→statement) and section gap (statement→action), with half-leading compensated so the RENDERED ink intervals — not the box gaps — carry the rank.

defects.defect: Nothing about the plate is container-scaled, and the type pair's ratio drifts 19.5% across the viewport range because one arm is fluid and the other is frozen.

Frame: probes/state-320-admintags.png.

defects.reproduction: Playwright viewport 320x900 → http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags; compare computed padding/gap/font-size against 1440x900.

defects.defect: The 26ch/36ch/44ch measures are font-relative across three families, so the authored ladder does not render — and the headline's measure is inert on every plate the component currently occupies.

Law: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:73 §5.8 "token presence alone cannot close a row."

defects.proposedCure: Express all three measures in one shared measure token (or one font's ch), so the authored ladder is the rendered ladder and the crossover threshold is chosen rather than accidental.

elements.

defects.defect: Unbreakable content in `message` is silently clipped at both edges with no scroll or ellipsis, and long `hint`/`detail` grow the plate without bound — while only one of four text arms carries `break-words`.

's textContent to `Nosavedpalettesyetnorwillthereeverbeanyonthisparticularplateever` and measure its rect against the plate rect.

defects.defect: The mark mirrors under RTL — the asymmetric 32/44/24 composition flips, because it is built from flex children rather than one direction-invariant primitive.

defects.defect: The loading|error|empty|populated state machine has no owner, so it is re-wired across two shared components plus inline blocks in seven files, and each host re-decides the branch order.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:2-3 deliberately excludes loading. The machine is spread across demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue (error+empty), demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminListSkeleton.vue, demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteCardSkeleton.vue, plus inline Skeleton blocks in BrowsePane.vue, AdminUsersPanel.vue, AdminTagsPanel.vue, AdminAuditPanel.vue, AdminNamesPanel.vue, AdminFlaggedPanel.vue and ExtractWorkbench.vue. defects.proposedCure: One `<FieldState>` wrapper owning the four-state switch, its live region (bound to the field, so both directions announce) and its transition — with `FieldSkeleton`, `FieldFailure` and `EmptyInvitation` as its three arms.

defects.defect: Forced-colors mode strips the content colours but keeps the ornament's author colour, promoting the decoration to the only coloured ink on the plate.

Frames: probes/forced-colors-admintags.png and visual/shots/forced-colors-desktop/adminusers.png — the trio is the only colour left on an otherwise black-on-white plate. Law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:84 requires state distinctness "in both schemes, forced colors and reduced transparency".
defects.mechanism: no forced-colors design at the species level; the plate inherits whatever the producer leaks
defects.reproduction:
Playwright context `{ forcedColors: "active" }` → http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags; read computed color on the

s and backgroundColor on the `.watercolor-swatch` spans.
defects.proposedCure: Decide `forced-color-adjust` once, inside the `EmptyPaletteMark` primitive — an absence mark should resolve to a system boundary colour, not survive as the page's only chroma.

defects.defect: Motion belongs to the hosts rather than the species, so four of five Admin routes swap a 185–218px slab with a hard v-if pop while BrowsePane gets a spring.
defects.evidence: `grep -c Transition`: BrowsePane.vue 1 (`<Transition name="vj-morph" mode="out-in">` at :40), AdminUsersPanel.vue 3, MixSourceSelector.vue 4, AdminTagsPanel.vue 0, AdminAuditPanel.vue 0, AdminNamesPanel.vue 0, AdminFlaggedPanel.vue 0. EmptyState.vue declares no @keyframes, no transition, no `--animation-slide-*` and no prefers-reduced-motion branch. BrowsePane.vue:29-40 carries a comment insisting the swap must "SETTLE into the wall on the snappy spring instead of a hard v-if POP" — and only BrowsePane gets it. Law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:141 §6 "No full-slab remount hole." Edict 6.
defects.mechanism: motion authored per host instead of per species, so it exists at 3 of 16 addresses by accident of authorship
defects.reproduction: Compare demo/palettes/BrowsePane.vue:40 with demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminTagsPanel.vue:49-83 — the same species, one wrapped in a Transition and one not.
defects.proposedCure: The species owns its enter/exit — a tokenized glass-ui transition on the `<FieldState>` wrapper, with a `prefers-reduced-motion` branch resolving directly to final geometry. Hosts stop deciding.

defects.defect: The live-region design is asymmetric and reads the ornament aloud: role="status" is bound to the empty branch (so only one direction of the state change announces), and role="alert" wraps a focusable Retry button.
defects.evidence: EmptyState.vue:28 sets role="status" (implicit aria-live=polite + aria-atomic=true) on the empty branch, so "became empty" announces and "results arrived" never does — the region unmounts. Measured accessible text: "· no tags minted ·No tags yet." (the eyebrow is not aria-hidden). EmptyState.vue:17 sets role="alert" (assertive) on a container whose #action slot holds a focusable <button>Retry</button> — measured on /#/browse: role=alert with children svg / p / p / button. Two role="status" regions coexist on /#/admin/tags. Law: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:114 "changed result count/state through the OWNING status region".
defects.mechanism: the live region was attached to a state instead of to the field, and made atomic over decorative content
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags — `document.querySelectorAll('[role="status"]').length === 2`; textContent of each includes the `·` frame.
defects.proposedCure: Move the live region to the field wrapper so both empty→populated and populated→empty announce; aria-hide the ornamental eyebrow frame; make the failure region polite-with-focus-management rather than assertive-with-orphan-button.

defects.defect: The `· … ·` frame is presentation encoded in eleven content strings, and one call site restates the component's own default verbatim.

The bullets enter the accessible name (measured: "· no tags minted ·No tags yet.").
defects.mechanism: presentation leaked into content — the label species' frame is retyped by every consumer instead of drawn by the species
defects.reproduction: `for f in $(grep -rl "<EmptyState" --include=*.vue demo/); do perl -0777 -ne 'while(/<EmptyState\b(.*?)(?:\/>|>)/gs){print}' $f; done` — 11 of 16 sites carry a hand-typed `·` pair.

defects.defect: The mark is mechanically flex-centred but optically off-axis — its ink centroid sits 2.8px left of the copy axis.

defects.reproduction:
http://localhost:9000/#/admin/tags — read the three dots' rects and the parent

's centre.

defects.defect: Non-idiomatic Vue 3.5: `withDefaults(defineProps<…>(), …)` rather than reactive props destructure with defaults.

result.axis: design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-system boundary, proportion/seat law) — component `demo/shared/ui/PaneHeader.vue`, the sole route-identity surface for 9 panes
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]`. Explicitly declared at spawn; served tier agrees. Not inherited, not undeclared.
result.strongestDefect: D-1/D-2 (one family): `--pane-title-shrink-ratio: calc(tan(atan2(var(--type-heading), var(--type-display-1))))` at PaneHeader.vue:140-142 resolves to a DIFFERENT, WRONG number in WebKit at both named bands. At 390px it resolves to 1.619766 where the file's own law (`:137-139`) demands exactly 1.0 — so on Safari phone the pane title GROWS 1.62x on scroll (ink 27.16 -> 43.99px) and overflows a 68.97px band, colliding with the collapse chevron. At 1440px it resolves to 0.310797 vs the law's 0.618 (Chromium: 0.618016) — the title collapses to 13.67px of ink, smaller than the body mono beneath it, inverting the pane's own hierarchy. Strongest because it is (a) shipped and visible on the primary target engine, (b) wrong in both directions at the two bands, (c) invisible to the @supports gate the file relies on (CSS.supports for atan2 returns true in WebKit), and (d) curable in one token: `calc(var(--type-heading) / var(--type-display-1))` measures 0.618016 in BOTH engines at 1440 and 1.000000 in BOTH at 390.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. defects.mechanism: CSS-arithmetic-as-design-law. WebKit degrades the <angle> returned by atan2() to a bare <number>, and tan() then correctly reads a bare number as radians: tan(atan2(1.618rem,1.618rem)) evaluates as tan(45 radians) = 1.6197751 instead of tan(45deg) = 1. Isolates prove it is argument-specific, not a blanket bug: tan(45deg)*1000px = 1000px and tan(atan2(1px,1px))*1000px = 1000px are both CORRECT in WebKit; only the rem/clamp arm fails. The @supports gate at :177 cannot catch it — CSS.supports for atan2 returns true in WebKit.
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/PaneHeader/probe-shrink-ratio.mjs (dev server live on :9000). Or: open http://localhost:9000/#/gradient in Safari at 390px width, scroll the pane 120px; the title enlarges.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the trig. `--pane-title-shrink-ratio: calc(var(--type-heading) / var(--type-display-1))`. Also AdminPane.vue:5 nests a <Badge> inside the <h3>, folding the count into the heading's accessible name and scaling it to 0.31x on WebKit desktop (PROPORTION-AUDIT §5.2, 'one identity line'). zoom-200 rest is fine (visual/shots/zoom-200-desktop/gradient.png); zoom-200 STUCK is UNMEASURED — HYPOTHESIS: 200% zoom halves the layout viewport to 720px, putting --type-display-1 on its fluid arm rather than at the cap, so D-1/D-2's WebKit fault will land on a third distinct value.
defects.mechanism: The component was designed once, at rest, and its other states were reasoned about in prose comments instead of being looked at. Every BLOCKER and MAJOR above is in a state other than rest.
defects.reproduction: Read PaneHeader.vue:21 and demo/palettes/admin/AdminPane.vue:3-6, 118-121. Frames: visual/shots/safari-desktop-dark/browse.png, visual/shots/zoom-200-desktop/gradient.png. The zoom-200-stuck row is explicitly labelled a hypothesis and has NO reproduction.
defects.proposedCure: Enumerate the states in the component's own contract before restyling: a title slot with a required non-empty invariant; a pending affordance owned by the header (not only by the body) so the identity surface carries operation truth per §4.1; the Badge moved OUT of the <h3> to a sibling in the identity line; and the route-H1 focus target from D-6. Then re-run the full state matrix — including zoom-200 STUCK, which nobody has measured.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction, public surface) for demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]) — the model this seat was explicitly spawned with; declared, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: L-1 — the ErrorBoundary latches the entire application dead across navigation. `caught` is component-local state on a component whose lifetime is the app's, while the failing unit is a pane keyed by `PaneSlot.liveKey`; the boundary can never learn the failure is stale. Live probe: after a catch, navigating to `/#/palettes` changes `location.hash` but `.pane-container` is still absent and the error plate still renders — the dock keeps accepting clicks over a corpse. Only a full reload recovers. The component's one job (recovery) does not work, and its Retry button is a visible no-op.
result.negativeProof: Not applicable to the verdict (DEFECTIVE), but recorded so later seats do not re-litigate the clean axes: (1) value.js consumption is clean BY ABSENCE — ErrorBoundary.vue:39-41 imports only `vue`, `@lucide/vue`, `../ui/button`; zero `@mkbabb/value.js`, zero `@src/*`, zero reach into `src/`. package.json#exports is a closed 8-key set and the file touches none of it, so there is no false proof of the public API — an external consumer could write this file verbatim given glass-ui. (2) Not a god module: 87 lines, one responsibility, no composables of its own. (3) `verbatimModuleSyntax` has nothing to violate — every imported binding is a value. (4) Vue 3.5 idioms correct: `useTemplateRef` at :57, reactive props destructure with defaults at :43-51, typed `defineEmits` at :53. (5) None of the named historical suspects (local useLayerTransition, usePaletteExport dual path, triplicate useDark) touch this file — it imports no composable at all. (6) `@lucide/vue` as a devDependency is correct: glass-ui declares it a peerDependency and the demo is not published (package.json#files = ["dist","!dist/gh-pages",...]). (7) The rendered plate itself is correct — the U-F58 a11y contract (role=alert, aria-live=assertive, focus-managed, named, visible affordance) is genuinely met; visual REPORT.md over 60 Safari captures shows pageErrors=0, blankOrNearBlank=0. The defect is that the affordance the plate offers is a lie, not that the plate is wrong.

defects.defect: Error containment is owned at an altitude that cannot know when the failure is stale: the single App-level ErrorBoundary latches the whole application dead across navigation and across its own Retry, recoverable only by full page reload. Blast radius is the entire pane grid plus every KeepAlive cache.
defects.evidence:
demo/color-picker/App.vue:47-50 opens ONE boundary around the whole grid, closes at :139-141 (no @reset listener). `caught` is a bare ref at ErrorBoundary.vue:55; the failing unit is keyed at demo/shell/PaneSlot.vue:113-119 (`:key="liveKey"`). Live probe `node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/live-latch.mjs` output: instances_with_onErrorCaptured: [{"name":"ErrorBoundary","depth":1}] / after_catch: {"paneContainerPresent":false,"focusTag":"vj-error-boundary flex flex-col items-ce"} / after_navigation_to_/palettes: {"hash":"#/palettes","paneContainerPresent":false,"mainText":"This panel hit an unexpected error.

L-probe induced render throw

Try again"} / after_reload: {"alerts":1,"paneContainerPresent":true}. Unit probes P1+P2 in probes/boundary.test.ts (6/6 pass).
defects.mechanism: wrong-altitude ownership — state about "which pane is currently failing" is stored on the application, not on the pane; unique semantic ownership violated
defects.reproduction: 1) dev server at localhost:9000; 2) run `node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/live-latch.mjs` — it walks the live Vue tree, fires the single onErrorCaptured hook exactly as Vue's handleError does, then sets location.hash='#/palettes'; 3) observe hash changes to #/palettes while .pane-container remains absent and the error plate still renders. Isolated: `npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.config.ts` P2 — replace the slotted component outright, boundary stays latched, healthy replacement never mounts.
defects.proposedCure: Architectural transposition: move containment INTO demo/shell/PaneSlot.vue where the key already lives — `<PaneErrorBoundary :key="liveKey" @retry="remount"><component :is="liveComponent" :key="liveKey"/></PaneErrorBoundary>` inside the existing KeepAlive. `:key="liveKey"` is the whole fix for the latch: a view change destroys the boundary instance with the pane it guarded, so `caught` cannot outlive its subject. Blast radius drops from the application to one slot. App.vue then holds ZERO boundary markup — the shell owns pane containment, which is what a shell is for.

defects.defect: The error plate is a drifted hand-copy of EmptyState's `error` variant — two homes for one concept, with constants that have already diverged.
defects.evidence: `diff <(sed -n '14,27p' demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue) <(sed -n '15,34p' demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue)` — same glyph, same font stack, same plate-ink detail line, byte-identical scoped `.plate-ink` rule; diverged: gap-2.5 vs gap-3, py-8 vs py-10, w-6 h-6 vs w-7 h-7, max-w-[26ch] vs [28ch], max-w-[44ch] vs [46ch]. ErrorBoundary.vue:12-14 names the duplication as deliberate. EmptyState has 7 error-variant consumers (BrowsePane.vue:64, AdminTagsPanel.vue:70, AdminAuditPanel.vue:44, AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:24, AdminUsersPanel.vue:53, AdminNamesPanel.vue:32,82); this is a silent 8th no design change will reach.
defects.mechanism: ownership duplication — one concept, two homes, drifting independently
defects.reproduction: Run the diff command above; the 5 divergent constants are the drift.
defects.proposedCure: Extract demo/shared/ui/ErrorPlate.vue (glyph + statement + machine-truth detail + #action slot, ONE set of constants). EmptyState composes it for variant='error' — better, sheds its error branch and its `variant` discriminator entirely and becomes what its name says. PaneErrorBoundary composes it and fills #action with Retry.

defects.defect: The boundary is a terminal, unreportable sink: `return false` suppresses Vue's own logError, the app installs no error handler of any kind, and the async failure class is structurally uncatchable.
defects.evidence: ErrorBoundary.vue:68 `return false`. node_modules/@vue/runtime-core/dist/runtime-core.cjs.js:238-239 — `if (errorCapturedHooks[i](...) === false) { return; }` — early return skips logError at :256 (the 'Unhandled error during execution of…' warn + rethrow-in-dev). `grep -rn "errorHandler|onErrorCaptured|unhandledrejection|window.onerror" demo/ src/` returns 4 matches, ALL inside ErrorBoundary.vue. demo/color-picker/index.html:205-213 is the whole boot: createApp/use(router)/mount — no app.config.errorHandler. Probe P4: on catch `w.emitted()` deep-equals {} — no event, no callback, no reporter. Probe P5: a raw promise/setTimeout escape never reaches the hook. The visual audit's one console error (audit/visual/REPORT.md §consoleErrors: 'safari-desktop-light /#/: WebGL: context lost.') is exactly this uncatchable class.
defects.mechanism: three responsibilities (containment / presentation / reporting) collapsed into one file, two of which then have no home at all
defects.reproduction: `npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.config.ts` — P4 asserts no console.error/console.warn carries the thrown message and w.emitted() === {}; P5 asserts an async throw leaves the boundary unfired and the pane rendering 'fine'.
defects.proposedCure: Split reporting out to the boot directory whose actual job it is: demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useErrorReporting.ts installs app.config.errorHandler + window.onerror + unhandledrejection — ONE place that knows how a failure is recorded, and it covers the async half a boundary structurally cannot. The boundary emits `caught: [err: unknown, info: string]` and stops owning the decision.

defects.defect: demo/ui/ is a 19-directory back-compat alias layer over glass-ui that ErrorBoundary reaches through, and it systematically degrades glass-ui's published narrow-subpath surface into a root-barrel reach.
defects.evidence: ErrorBoundary.vue:41 `import { Button } from "../ui/button"`. demo/ui/button/index.ts in full: `export { Button } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`. 18 of 19 barrels are exactly this. demo/ui/alert/index.ts:1-10 self-documents the shim: 'converted it to a re-export … The two consumers import from this barrel UNCHANGED.' glass-ui publishes ./button. Measured: `wc -c` → dist/glass-ui.js 25239 B / 47 top-level import-export statements vs dist/button.js 71 B / 2. Dev: `curl -s localhost:9000/@fs/.../demo/ui/button/index.ts` → resolves to node_modules/.vite/deps/@mkbabb_glass-ui.js, `ls -la` → 231357 bytes, against @mkbabb_glass-ui_chip.js at 103 bytes. Repo split: 37 root-barrel vs 82 subpath imports. demo/shared/utils.ts:8-18 documents the identical argument as settled practice ('the root-barrel shed').
defects.mechanism: legacy back-compat shim layer (edict 2) that also inverts the published-subpath consumption discipline
defects.reproduction: `cat demo/ui/button/index.ts` (one line); `wc -c node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/glass-ui.js node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/button.js` → 25239 / 71; `ls -la node_modules/.vite/deps/ | grep glass` → 231357 for the root prebundle. HONEST CAVEAT: not the marginal cost on the boot path — App.vue:194-196 already root-barrels useClipboard, so the chunk is eager regardless. The finding is the LAYER, not this one edge.
defects.proposedCure: Delete demo/ui/ outright. Every consumer imports @mkbabb/glass-ui/<subpath> directly (ErrorBoundary → @mkbabb/glass-ui/button). That is what edict 4 means by 'glass-ui is the design system' — you name it, you do not shadow it. demo/ui/alert's 10 lines of genuine comment become an ADR note, not a module.

defects.defect: The demo's import-boundary invariants are dead code: every no-restricted-imports glob targets demo/@, a tree deleted at W43. ErrorBoundary.vue is governed by exactly zero enforceable boundaries.
defects.evidence: eslint.config.js:232-239 globs `demo/@/components/**`, `demo/@/lib/**`; :275-278 globs `demo/@/composables/**`. `ls -d demo/@` → 'No such file or directory' (deleted at bc06a0cd 'demo @-alias death' / a61094e3). `npx eslint --print-config demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue` → the sole surviving pattern is `@components/custom/palette-browser/**/*.vue`, and tsconfig.demo.json:33-34 states 'No @styles/@components/@utils/@lib/@composables/@assets project alias survives.'
defects.mechanism: guard rails left pointed at a deleted tree — a rule matching zero files reads GREEN forever
defects.reproduction: `ls -d demo/@` → No such file or directory. `npx eslint --print-config demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue | jq '.rules["no-restricted-imports"]'` → one pattern, targeting an alias that no longer resolves.
defects.proposedCure: Re-aim G-DEMO-1/3a/3b onto the live physical homes (demo/color-session, demo/palettes, demo/shell, demo/shared, demo/workbenches, demo/scenes, demo/platform), and add the layering ban that would have caught L-6 (demo/color-picker/** may hold App.vue + boot composables only; a component exported from the boot root is a mis-homing). Then add a one-line `lint:boundaries` gate asserting every declared glob matches >=1 file — a rule whose glob matches nothing must fail CI as loudly as a rule that is violated.

defects.defect: The component is homed in the Vite ROOT — the boot/entry directory — rather than in the UI layer, making it the one non-boot artifact among 16 boot artifacts and root-relative HTTP addressable while its concept-sibling is not.

defects.mechanism: wrong home — a reusable presentational component placed in the boot/entry surface
defects.reproduction: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\n' http://localhost:9000/ErrorBoundary.vue` → 200 12546; `curl` the same for /shared/ui/EmptyState.vue → 200 13183 (index.html fallback). The asymmetry is the lattice reporting the mis-homing.
defects.proposedCure: demo/shell/PaneErrorBoundary.vue (containment, beside PaneSlot.vue which will own it) + demo/shared/ui/ErrorPlate.vue (presentation, beside EmptyState.vue and PaneHeader.vue). demo/color-picker/ returns to holding only what boots the app.

defects.defect: The component's entire declared public surface is dead: two props and one event, none of which is exercised by its single consumer.
defects.evidence: ErrorBoundary.vue:43-51 declares `message` (default 'This panel hit an unexpected error.') and `retryLabel` (default 'Try again'); :53 declares emit `reset`, fired at :74. `sed -n '50p' demo/color-picker/App.vue` → `<ErrorBoundary message="This panel hit an unexpected error.">` — the message passed is byte-identical to the default, retryLabel is never passed anywhere in the repo, and no @reset listener is declared.
defects.mechanism: speculative API — contrivance for a single-consumer component (edict 3)
defects.reproduction: `sed -n '50p' demo/color-picker/App.vue` and compare to ErrorBoundary.vue:44; `grep -rn 'retryLabel' demo/` returns only the declaration; `grep -rn '@reset' demo/` returns nothing for ErrorBoundary.
defects.proposedCure: Collapse the props to nothing, or make `reset` load-bearing: under the L-1 cure it becomes `retry`, which PaneSlot listens to and answers by bumping liveKey — a real remount instead of a decorative event.

defects.defect: `.plate-ink` is copy-pasted into five <style scoped> blocks as a per-component override instead of living once in demo/styles/utils.css.

All five bodies byte-identical: `color: var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground));`. demo/styles/utils.css already holds exactly this species (.section-subtitle, .skeleton-ink-register, .fraunces, .fira-code).

defects.reproduction: `for f in <the 5 files>; do grep -A2 '^\.plate-ink' $f; done` — five identical three-line rules.
defects.proposedCure: One rule in demo/styles/utils.css beside .section-subtitle; delete all five scoped blocks.

defects.defect: `vj-error-boundary` is a dead class — emitted into the DOM on every catch but with no CSS rule, no selector, no test hook anywhere in the repo.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "vj-error-boundary" demo/ src/ e2e/ test/` returns exactly one line: demo/color-picker/ErrorBoundary.vue:18. Probe P6 confirms it is emitted (`w.find('.vj-error-boundary').exists()` === true), and the live probe's after_catch.focusTag shows it on the focused element.
defects.mechanism: a name with no referent — dead code
defects.reproduction: `grep -rn "vj-error-boundary" demo/ src/ e2e/ test/` → 1 hit, the emission site.
defects.proposedCure: Decide which it is. If a styling hook, give it a rule; if a test hook, make it `data-slot="error-boundary"` matching the existing convention at EmptyState.vue:41 (`data-slot="empty-state-trio"`) — then L-11's e2e can bind to it instead of DOM order.

defects.defect: 'Try again' is a dead affordance for the deterministic case: reset remounts the identical subtree with identical inputs and re-catches within the same tick, so the user sees a button that visibly does nothing.
defects.evidence: ErrorBoundary.vue:71-75 `reset()` sets caught=false, detail=null, emit('reset') — it changes no input to the subtree. Probe P3: after `w.find('button').trigger('click')`, `w.find('[role="alert"]').exists()` is still true; `w.emitted('reset')` is truthy and, per L-7, nobody is listening.
defects.mechanism: downstream of L-1 — a meaningful retry must change something (refetch, bump the mount key), and neither is reachable from a component that owns only a boolean
defects.reproduction: `npx vitest run --config docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/ErrorBoundary/probes/vitest.config.ts` — P3.
defects.proposedCure: Under the L-1 cure the boundary emits `retry`, PaneSlot bumps liveKey, and the pane genuinely remounts cold — Retry becomes a real affordance instead of a decorative one.

defects.defect: The only test of this core-shell component lives in the admin feature's e2e suite and reaches it through a feature bug; its selector aliases across three independently-owned role=alert surfaces.
defects.evidence: `grep -rln "ErrorBoundary|onErrorCaptured" test/ e2e/` → e2e/smoke/admin/a11y-authed-admin.spec.ts only. That spec (:107-156) induces the throw by serving {slug:null} so AdminUsersPanel's slugHead(null) throws in a v-for; the assertion is `page.getByRole("alert").filter({visible:true}).first()`. Three owners publish role=alert: ErrorBoundary.vue:19, EmptyState.vue:17, ApiOfflineChip.vue:13. The live probe caught TWO mounted simultaneously — after_catch.alerts lists the misconfig chip FIRST in DOM order, ahead of the boundary.
defects.mechanism: test coverage of a core component held hostage by a feature defect, plus DOM-order-dependent selection across duplicated semantics (the L-2 duplication surfacing in the test layer)
defects.reproduction: `grep -rln 'ErrorBoundary|onErrorCaptured' test/ e2e/` → one file. Run live-latch.mjs and read after_catch.alerts: ["dev misconfigured — run `npm run dev`", "This panel hit an unexpected error.…"] — the chip precedes the boundary.
defects.proposedCure: Move boundary coverage into test/ as a unit suite (the probes in this directory are a working starting point — no browser, no auth, no fixture) and give the boundary a stable data-slot for e2e binding. The admin spec then keeps only what it is actually about: that an admin render failure is announced.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction, public surface) for demo/color-session/color-chips/PreviewStrip.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — exact model ID claude-opus-5[1m] (1M context). Declared at spawn, not inherited.

defects.defect: Wrong-direction module edge: the DISCRETE preview chip imports from the CONTINUOUS-ramp library sampler solely to reach a one-line string join, coupling a 76-line presentational leaf to the whole color engine. The barrel amplifies it — index.ts exports the two components AND the sampler from one entry, so every consumer of PreviewStrip takes the sampler edge unconditionally.
defects.evidence: demo/color-session/color-chips/PreviewStrip.vue:22 `import { stampStops } from "./sample";` — the imported symbol is `stops.join("|")` at sample.ts:89-91, zero color dependencies. sample.ts:2-3 self-describes as "the LIBRARY-sampling helper"; its value imports are sample.ts:27-31 (`mixColors` from `@mkbabb/value.js/color`), :32 (`colorToCss, parseColorIn` from `../color-utils`). MEASURED closure (scratchpad/PSL-closure.mjs): 4 relative modules / 15,830 B — PreviewStrip.vue 2615B, sample.ts 3721B, color-utils.ts 1092B, picker-color.ts 8402B — plus bare `@mkbabb/value.js/color` AND `@mkbabb/value.js/css`, both VALUE imports (picker-color.ts:1-27 pulls 20 runtime bindings; :28-34 pulls parseCssColor+serializeCssColor). Published bytes reachable: `ls -la dist/subpaths/*.js dist/*.js` → color.js 604 + css.js 43973 + anchors 12472 + operations 6829 + result 100 = 63,978 B ≈ 62.5 KiB. Barrel closure (index.ts): 6 modules / 19,113 B, same two subpaths.
defects.mechanism: Symbol misfiled by concept: `stampStops` is the chip↔oracle DOM wire protocol, not a sampling concern, and was filed inside the sampler module. A presentational leaf therefore inherits the color engine transitively; the fused barrel makes the edge unavoidable for every consumer.
defects.reproduction: node /private/tmp/claude-504/-Users-mkbabb-Programming-value-js/6614e90c-8bd6-434f-b017-5ad4277c6e5e/scratchpad/PSL-closure.mjs demo/color-session/color-chips/PreviewStrip.vue demo/color-session/color-chips/index.ts — output pasted verbatim in report §1.
defects.proposedCure: Architectural transposition, not a patch: move the chip UP to demo/shared/ui/ (the directory already exists — EmptyState.vue, PaneHeader.vue — so no new dir, edict 3 satisfied), where a shared/ui leaf structurally CANNOT reach color-session/sample.ts. `stampStops` does not move — it is deleted along with the `data-stops` attribute when the protocol becomes 'the stops that are painted' (see L-7 cure). Gate G-1: relative closure = 1 module, bare specifiers = {vue} only.

defects.defect: 'Serialize a color for a preview chip' has three homes emitting three incompatible CSS forms into one untyped `stops: readonly string[]` prop; one of the three hand-rolls CSS-color serialization that the published @mkbabb/value.js/css surface already owns. The consequence is a RED oracle at HEAD.
defects.evidence: THREE PRODUCERS: (1) sample.ts:39-41 `serializeStop` = colorToCss(stop,"oklch") + `.replace(/ \/ 1\)$/, ")")`; (2) generate-color.ts:235-243 `generatedCss` = mapColorToGamut → serializeCssColor, measured live as "oklch(88.673398030922% 0.060467090141 33.371415752918deg)"; (3) aurora-harmony-stops.ts:26-28,38 = local `fmt` (`v.toFixed(4).replace(/\.?0+$/,"")`) + template literal, library serializer BYPASSED. CONSEQUENCE, run at HEAD 32b4040e: `VJS_E2E_PORT=9000 npx playwright test --project=smoke e2e/smoke/oracles/o20-generate-plate.spec.ts --reporter=list` → "1 failed, 1 passed (43.1s)"; failure at spec:105 — Expected "oklch(89.858355603181% 0.068344892119 162.556336484849deg)" (stamped) vs Received "oklch(0.898584 0.0683449 162.556)" (getComputedStyle). Numerically identical, textually never equal. Origin: `git log -S "serializeCssColor(mapped.value)"` → a68ecdc1 "feat(demo)!: v4 consumer migration".
defects.mechanism: The chip's contract is the library's STRING FORM rather than a value. With no branded type and no single adapter, three producers mint three forms, and a v4 library serialization change silently broke a demo-side oracle that was pinned to the form.
defects.reproduction: VJS_E2E_PORT=9000 npx playwright test --project=smoke e2e/smoke/oracles/o20-generate-plate.spec.ts --reporter=list (output pasted above). Live three-leg comparison: node scratchpad/PSL-probe2.mjs → o20WouldPass:false, plus the strip's painted segments vs stamp.
defects.proposedCure: One branded `PaintableStop = string & {__brand}` minted by ONE adapter (`demo/color-session/stops.ts`, toPaintableStop(color): PaintableStop | null). Every producer routes through it; generate-color's three throws and aurora-harmony-stops' `fmt` delete. The chip types on `readonly PaintableStop[]` so a raw string[] cannot reach it, and the oracle compares PARSED colors (parseCssColor both sides, ≤1e-9 per channel) — form-independent, which also retires o14's hand-written parseOklchTriples regex (a fourth re-derivation of the serializer grammar). NOTE: the o20 RED itself is already filed at registry/DEFECT-LEDGER.md:4480, 20007, 20990 by the wb-generate-controls seat; NEW here is the three-producer census and the library-structure mechanism.

defects.defect: 'Show a palette truncated in a small space' has FOUR independent implementations with three magic caps and three different truncation grammars — and one of them truncates SILENTLY, violating the honest-truncation law that PreviewStrip itself legislates in prose.
defects.evidence: CENSUS: (1) demo/color-session/color-chips/PreviewStrip.vue:25 cap=7 via module-PRIVATE `const STRIP_SEGMENT_CAP = 7`, mask-image fade at :73-75; (2) demo/palettes/browser/dialog/VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:53 cap=8 via `.slice(0, 8)` literal, honest `+{{ n-8 }}` affordance at :58-63; (3) demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:52-58 cap=5 via `.slice(0, 5)` literal with NO affordance — a flagged 12-color palette reads as a complete 5-color palette; (4) demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteColorStrip.vue — no cap, weighted widths. defects.defect: `data-stops` carries two mutually contradictory referents (truth-function output vs painted output); above the 7-segment cap the component's own documented truth law is false by construction.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:44 stamps `stampStops(stops)` (ALL stops) while the template at :49-51 paints `visible` = `stops.slice(0,7)` (:32-35). Measured live, both engines: `chromium · count=12 { n: 12, painted: 7 }`, `webkit · count=12 { n: 12, painted: 7 }`, `chromium · count=8 { n: 8, painted: 7 }`. The file's own header at :6-8 asserts "the strip stamps them on `data-stops` and paints them as equal hard segments". o14-preview-truth.spec.ts:33 states the law for the ramp species: "the painted gradient must embed exactly those stops".
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — one attribute overloaded with two referents that the cap makes provably unequal
defects.reproduction: http://localhost:9000/#/generate -> focus the "Color count" slider -> ArrowRight to 12 -> open the "Generation preset" combobox -> for any chip: `el.getAttribute("data-stops").split("|").length === 12` while `el.children.length === 7`.
defects.proposedCure: Split the referents at the seam instead of overloading one attribute: the chip stamps WHAT IT PAINTS (`:data-stops="stampStops(visible)"`), and the host — which owns the truth function — stamps the total on the row it owns (`:data-preview-total="stops.length"` on the SelectItem). Then o14's paint-equals-stamp law becomes true for the strip species for the first time and o20's seed-exact law reads the whole truth-function output. Cleaner gestalt: delete the cap from the chip entirely — a chip whose job is "paint the stops you are given" has no business silently discarding five of them; let the host decide how many stops to hand over.

defects.defect: The golden-plate law is asserted in `em` and written in `rem`; the plate measurably is not phi-squared, and the two engines disagree. `display: inline-flex` is inert dead code.

Also measured `display: "flex"` in BOTH engines despite `display: inline-flex` at :57 — the chip is a flex item of the #description wrapper (GenerateControls.vue:244) and is blockified per CSS Display §2.7.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the shared law has no root, so its units drifted from its own comment

The defect is invisible to every DOM-level probe because the canvas is `pointer-events:none`, so `elementFromPoint`, rects, computed styles and the a11y tree all report a healthy plate.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so no negative is claimed. For completeness, the axes that ARE clean, with positive evidence: (1) Vue 3.5 idioms (edict 7) — `useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>("alertRef")` at ErrorBoundary.vue:57, reactive props destructure with defaults at 43-51 (not `withDefaults`), type-only `defineProps`/`defineEmits`; correct on all three counts. (2) `verbatimModuleSyntax` (edict 8) — lines 39-41 import only runtime values (`ref`, `nextTick`, `onErrorCaptured`, `useTemplateRef`, `CircleAlert`, `RotateCcw`, `Button`); there are no type-only imports to mark, so nothing to violate. (3) Component-boundary provenance — `demo/ui/button/index.ts` is a one-line `export { Button } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`, so the producer component is used, not re-implemented (only its styling is per-instance overridden, D-6). (5) `return false` from `onErrorCaptured` (line 68) correctly halts propagation to `app.config.errorHandler`, which is what a boundary owning the failure should do. (6) Hover/press/disabled states are correctly delegated to the glass-ui Button rather than re-styled.

defects.defect: A single caught error bricks the entire application permanently. Violates PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-08 (recovery is ADD-AFFORDANCE at the entity) and VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §5 ('Persistent operation state stays with the entity/workspace').

defects.defect: The sole recovery affordance cannot recover. Clicking 'Try again' re-mounts the identical subtree with identical inputs, so a deterministic failure re-throws inside the same tick; the plate returns and focus is dragged back off the button onto the container, re-firing the assertive alert.

defects.mechanism: F2 — the recovery affordance is decorative. `reset()` changes no input to the failing subtree: no remount key bump, no refetch, no attempt counter, no escalated copy, no alternative exit. defects.proposedCure: A retry must change an input — bump a remount key on the slot, refetch the failed resource, or hand the user a named route escape. After the first failed retry the plate must escalate (say the retry failed and offer the escape) rather than re-arm the same dead verb.

defects.defect: The colour specimen is invisible against the surface it is a specimen on. In /atmosphere light mode every one of the six harmony strips renders its terminal stop at 1.011-1.124 : 1 against the pixels 2px to its right; in /generate light the whole Pastel chip sits at 1.011-1.345 : 1; in /generate dark the whole Earth chip sits at 1.159-1.577 : 1. 22 of 24 measured chips carry at least one stop below the 3:1 non-text floor, 7 carry a stop below 1.15:1. The declared cure — the F8 inset hairline ring at --foreground 12% — itself measures 1.228-1.748 : 1 in light. The cure is fainter than the disease.
defects.evidence: Rendered-pixel census (Pillow over Playwright/WebKit DSF2 screenshots), probes-D/pixel-capture.mjs + probes-D/pixel-contrast.py: atmo-light Monochrome segCR=[3.340,2.141,1.412,1.011] ringCR=1.748; Triad MIN=1.028; gen-light Pastel segCR=[1.011,1.015,1.317,1.345,1.054] ringCR=1.228; gen-dark Earth segCR=[1.577,1.295,1.533,1.259,1.159] ringCR=1.183. Ring composited alone: probes-D/ring-contrast.mjs → light 1.256:1, dark 1.355:1. Source: PreviewStrip.vue:63-64 (the sole boundary). Frames: frames-D/D1-atmo-light-monochrome-6x.png, frames-D/D1-gen-light-pastel-6x.png (6x magnification; the ring is not visible on any edge).
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — a specimen with no well: opaque stops painted straight onto translucent menu glass, bounded only by a 1px INSET ring that bounds the plate rather than the stops, in a single channel (background-color) with no structural fallback. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §2 assigns palette specimens the 'specimen well — opaque/quiet neutral stage' tier; this one sits on the instrument-veil tier. §4.1: 'a token name is not evidence'.
defects.reproduction: Dev server on :9000. `node probes-D/pixel-capture.mjs && python3 probes-D/pixel-contrast.py` (copies at docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/PreviewStrip/probes-D/). Or by eye: open /#/atmosphere in light mode, open the Palette harmony select — the 4th stop of every strip is absent.
defects.proposedCure: Do not thicken the ring. Give the specimen its own well: the plate becomes an opaque neutral quiet stage (the same surface=opaque / tier=quiet material the canon already mandates for palette entity Cards, VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §3.1) with per-stop 1px neutral gutters, so terminal and adjacent stops stay countable regardless of what is behind the menu. Root that well in glass-ui (see D-8) rather than as another local constant.

defects.defect: Forced Colors Mode erases the component entirely and leaves a ~50px phantom indent. Every segment is forced to rgb(255,255,255) and the box-shadow ring is suppressed, so the chip becomes a white void on white canvas; the 42px + 8px gap reservation survives, pushing every description line 50px into its own row against nothing. On /atmosphere, where the chip is the row's ONLY content, the six harmony rows collapse to six identical labels with a blank second line.
defects.evidence: Chromium, forcedColors:'active', emulation verified in-page (matchMedia('(forced-colors: active)').matches === true): seg0.bg='rgb(255, 255, 255)', segLast.bg='rgb(255, 255, 255)', boxShadow='none', forcedColorAdjust='auto'. Frame frames-D/D2-forced-colors-vanished.png. Note the shipped visual matrix cannot see this: audit/visual/states.mjs:24 runs the forced-colors arm on WebKit, which does not honour the emulation — my WebKit re-run still reported live oklch() segment backgrounds and a live box-shadow, so that matrix arm is inconclusive.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — the entire payload is background-color, a forced property in Forced Colors Mode; the only boundary is a box-shadow, which is suppressed. forced-color-adjust is never declared (computes 'auto'). PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.7 — 'visual glyph size, operable target size and layout reservation are separate quantities' — the reservation outlives the glyph.
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/ratio-sweep-forced-rtl.mjs` (scenario forced-chromium), or launch Chromium with forcedColors:'active' at http://localhost:9000/#/generate and open the Generation preset select.
defects.proposedCure: A colour specimen cannot show colour in forced colors; it must show structure. The D-1 well supplies a ButtonBorder-tier frame that survives, and the per-stop gutters become 1px CanvasText rules so the strip still reports how many stops there are. If colour is judged the whole point, the honest alternative is to collapse the reservation under @media (forced-colors: active) rather than reserve 50px for nothing. Either is a decision; 'auto' is not.

defects.defect: The 'one golden plate' law is false at every viewport and drifts 31%. Measured width/height: 2.9911 at 320px and 390px (+14.25% vs phi^2), 2.8450 at 768px, 2.5548 at 1440px (-2.41%), 2.2886 at 2200px (-12.58%). Never 2.6180. Browser zoom compounds it: 200% zoom halves the CSS viewport, so a 1440px window renders the ~2.85 ratio of a 720px column. Compounding this, the literal 2.618rem is hardcoded in two files while two design tokens already carry that exact value.
defects.evidence: probes-D/ratio-sweep-forced-rtl.mjs SWEEP lines (log probes-D/ratio-sweep.log): 8 measurements, zero equal phi^2, spread 2.2886…2.9911. Source: PreviewStrip.vue:59 `inline-size: 2.618rem; /* one golden plate — phi^2 × 1em (F7) */` against `block-size: 1em` at :60; the local font-size is the vw-clamped `--type-caption: clamp(0.75rem, 0.71rem + 0.21vw, 1rem)`. Unused tokens: demo/styles/foundation.css:462 `--phi-4: 2.618rem` and glass-ui `--space-phi-5: 2.618rem` (grep -rn '2\.618' demo/ = 8 hits).
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the primitive was never rooted: inline-size is root-relative (rem) while block-size is locally inherited (em) on a vw-clamped token. Two axes on two scales cannot hold a constant ratio, so the declared relation is unexpressible in the code that declares it. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.8 verbatim: 'Real rendered relation wins over token intent... token presence alone cannot close a row.' Owner edict 5 (root-level styling) is breached twice by the hardcoded literal.
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/ratio-sweep-forced-rtl.mjs` and read the SWEEP lines; or measure `.preview-strip` getBoundingClientRect() with the Palette harmony menu open at 320px and at 2200px.
defects.proposedCure: One unit system, one token: `block-size: 1em; inline-size: calc(1em * var(--phi-2))`, hoisted to the shared root of D-8 so it is declared once. Then phi^2 is true by construction at every clamp arm and every zoom level. --radius-sm has the same disease in miniature (fixed 4px on a 14→18.3px plate); it must scale with the plate too.

defects.defect: Adjacent stops reach 1.002 : 1, so the 'n hard segments' grammar cannot be counted — a five-colour strip reads as three. There is no separation of any kind between segments.
defects.evidence: Rendered pixels, probes-D/pixel-contrast.py MINadj column: gen-light Pastel 1.004, Neon 1.019, Vibrant 1.033; gen-dark Neon 1.016, Pastel 1.038; computed-style census probes-D/model-contrast.log recorded Vibrant dark at 1.002. /atmosphere 1.308-1.489. Source: PreviewStrip.vue:67-70 — `.preview-strip-segment { flex: 1 1 0; block-size: 100% }`, no border, no gutter, no outline. Frame frames-D/D1-gen-light-pastel-6x.png.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — the stop count, which is the strip's whole semantic payload, is conveyed by colour difference alone with no structural fallback. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4.1: 'Selected, failed, pending, withdrawn and disabled states are never color-only.'
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/pixel-capture.mjs && python3 probes-D/pixel-contrast.py`, MINadj column. By eye: /#/generate light, open Generation preset, look at the Pastel and Neon rows.
defects.proposedCure: Fold into D-1's well: 1px neutral gutters between stops. The same mechanism also supplies the forced-colors arm of D-2 for free — one move, three findings closed.

defects.defect: The truncation affordance is a 4.5px alpha ramp on a 5.98px sliver, indistinguishable from a genuinely pale terminal stop — and invisible by construction on the Pastel preset, where every stop already measures <=1.345:1 against the row. Counts 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 (five of twelve reachable values) render identically as seven segments, so the chip cannot report which. The component's own stated F5 law — 'the strip a row shows is what selecting it yields' — is therefore false for 5 of 12 reachable counts, with no visual cue telling the reader which regime they are in.
defects.evidence: Count slider domain GenerateControls.vue:300-302 (:min=1 :max=12); cap PreviewStrip.vue:25 STRIP_SEGMENT_CAP=7; mask PreviewStrip.vue:73-74. Measured at count=12 (probes-D/states.mjs): stopCount 12, segCount 7, truncated true, segment width 5.984px each, mask 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0,0,0) 20%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 95%)' → the fade runs 1.20px→5.68px inside a 5.98px sliver. All ten rows [[12,7,true] × 10]. Frame frames-D/D5-count12-truncation-light.png. Docblock claim contradicted: PreviewStrip.vue:5-7.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — an elision STATE conveyed colour-only, at sub-perceptual scale, in the same channel as the data it is meant to be distinguished from. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.6 'Subtraction precedes explanation.' The N-4 note (PreviewStrip.vue:10-16) rejects widening the plate to protect 'the description-lane rhythm' — but /atmosphere already breaks that rhythm by +17.5% (D-6), so the rhythm being protected is not held.
defects.reproduction: /#/generate, drag Color count to 12, open the Generation preset select. Or `node probes-D/states.mjs` (scenario truncate-12).
defects.proposedCure: Either the plate elongates with the palette — a strip is allowed to be as long as its data — or the elision is reported structurally: a hairline tick per elided stop, or a '+5' numeral. Never an alpha ramp that mimics a colour. (The truth-law half of this defect is independently confirmed by the sibling seat at challenge-C-implementation.md §C-1/C-3/C-4.)

defects.defect: On /atmosphere the chip buys a +17.5% row-height tax to occupy 1.49% of a row it leaves ~95% empty, while contributing nothing to the accessibility tree. Harmony rows measure 51.69px; the Arrangement and Medium rows in the same pane measure 44.00px. The chip is the sole content of the SelectItem #description slot and is aria-hidden, so the row's entire accessible text is 'Analogous '.
defects.evidence: probes-D/rtl-forced-rhythm.mjs (scenario atmo-rhythm): Palette harmony [51.69,51.69,51.69]; Zone arrangement [44,44,44]; Painterly medium [44,44,44]. Pixel probe: rowW 889.86, rowH 51.69, chip 41.875x16.39, chipAreaSharePct 1.49. Accessible text of the first option measured as 'Analogous '. Source: AuroraPane.vue:130-134 (chip alone in #description); PreviewStrip.vue:43 aria-hidden. Frame frames-D/D6-atmosphere-row-acreage.png.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the primitive is used at footnote scale in a composition where it is the protagonist. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §3.2: 'Empty secondary content occupies at most a narrow invitation tray (<=15% of the stage) or disappears.' PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.5: a small mark is data, status, action, drag, focus register — or removed; here it is data whose only channel dies in forced colors and never reaches AT.
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/rtl-forced-rhythm.mjs` (scenario atmo-rhythm); or open /#/atmosphere and compare the Palette harmony menu row height with Zone arrangement and Painterly medium.
defects.proposedCure: On /atmosphere the chip IS the row's differentiator, so make it the row's protagonist: a leading plate in the name lane at the name's optical weight, items-center, one line, sized against the 890px available rather than 42px. That removes the second line and restores the 44px pane rhythm at the same time.

defects.defect: The truncation mask is a physical 90deg gradient inside a direction-aware flex row, so under RTL the elision cue inverts: the flex order reverses and the masked :last-child lands at the strip's outer left edge, while the mask keeps fading rightward — i.e. inward. The cue reads as a smear punched into the middle of the strip instead of a fade at its logical end.
defects.evidence: Measured direction chain under html[dir=rtl]: reka-ui's SelectContent carries a hard dir='ltr' (DIV dirAttr='ltr' class='relative z-popover overflow-hidden rounded-panel...'), so today the whole popover stays LTR inside an RTL document and the defect is masked by a producer bug. With that one attribute honoured (probes-D/rtl-forced-rhythm.mjs, scenario rtl-forced): direction 'rtl', chip spans x 1161.13…1203.00, segments run x 1197.02 → 1161.11 descending, and seg6 (the outer-left one) still carries mask 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0,0,0) 20%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 95%)'. Source PreviewStrip.vue:73-74. Frame frames-D/D7-rtl-mask-inverted.png.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — a physical direction keyword decorating a logical layout end. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §6.1: 'chrome, navigation and layout — logical inline/block direction follows the document.' Contingent, not latent-forever: it manifests the moment the obvious RTL fix lands on the producer.
defects.reproduction: `node probes-D/rtl-forced-rhythm.mjs` (scenario rtl-forced) — sets documentElement dir=rtl, opens the preset menu at count 12, then flips the popover's dir='ltr' to 'rtl' and re-measures.
defects.proposedCure: `mask-image: linear-gradient(to inline-end, ...)`. Better: adopt D-5's structural elision cue, which has no direction at all.

defects.defect: Design-system boundary breached four ways, all one mechanism. (1) `.preview-chip` is minted twice in two scoped blocks (PreviewStrip.vue:56-65, PreviewRamp.vue:40-49) — because both are scoped the shared name is a fiction, and they have already drifted (inline-flex vs inline-block; the F7/F8 rationale comment exists on one only). (2) A third mint of the same primitive is imported into the same file: GenerateControls.vue:16 PaletteColorStrip + :20 PreviewStrip, both 'n colour bands in a clipped aria-hidden box painted with background-color' — and PaletteColorStrip already carries the 8% segment legibility floor PreviewStrip most needs. (3) glass-ui 7.0.0 already exports ./chip (Chip, chipVariants, ChipProps) and owns the .glass-chip class family; demo/ mints a second, unrelated 'chip' vocabulary. (4) The plate width 2.618rem is hardcoded twice while --phi-4 (demo/styles/foundation.css:462) and --space-phi-5 (glass-ui) both hold that exact value.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:56-65 vs PreviewRamp.vue:40-49 (byte-similar, disjoint scopes). GenerateControls.vue:16,20. PaletteColorStrip.vue:44-72 (WEIGHT_FLOOR = 0.08). `node -e "...package.json exports"` → './chip' present; node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/chip/{types,chipVariants}.d.ts define Chip mode/shape/size/tone/surface and .glass-chip--cell/--icon. `grep -rn '2\.618' demo/` → 8 hits including foundation.css:462.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the primitive was never rooted. Owner edict 3 (KISS, no contrivance), edict 4 (glass-ui is the design system; reuse existing component-type names) and edict 5 (root-level styling, never per-instance) are each breached by the same absence of a shared root.
defects.reproduction: `grep -rn 'preview-chip' demo/` (two scoped definitions); `grep -n 'PaletteColorStrip\|PreviewStrip' demo/workbenches/generate/GenerateControls.vue`; `grep -rn '2\.618' demo/`.
defects.proposedCure: One primitive, rooted in glass-ui: a `swatch-strip` (or a Chip shape='specimen' variant) owning the well, the per-stop gutters, the forced-colors arm, the logical-direction elision cue, and the phi^2 plate in one unit system from one token. PreviewStrip, PreviewRamp and PaletteColorStrip become thin domain adapters over it. That single transposition closes D-1, D-2, D-3, D-4, D-7 and D-13 at once — the tell that it is the correct altitude.

defects.defect: A strip of one is a swatch wearing palette clothes. `v-if="stops.length >= 1"` admits count=1, producing a single 42x16 block still carrying the palette grammar — plate radius, plate ring, and the phi^2 proportion whose whole meaning is 'a sequence'. The sibling PreviewRamp sets its floor at >= 2 precisely because one stop is not a ramp.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:40 `v-if="stops.length >= 1"` vs PreviewRamp.vue:31 `v-if="stops.length >= 2"`. Count slider GenerateControls.vue:300 `:min="1"`.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the two members of a declared one-law family disagree about the floor of that law.
defects.reproduction: /#/generate, drag Color count to 1, open the Generation preset select.
defects.proposedCure: Raise the floor to 2 and let the single-colour case render the app's existing swatch species (WatercolorDot or the glass-ui Chip tone face), which is what one colour actually is.

defects.defect: A disabled option row would dim the colour specimen. SelectItem accepts `disabled` and glass-ui applies data-[disabled]:opacity-disabled to the row, which would composite the stops toward the row ground — a colour specimen at reduced alpha reports colours that are not the colours.
defects.evidence: glass-ui SelectItem props include `disabled: { type: Boolean }` (dist/select-BcBAyLXA.js) and the item class carries `data-[disabled]:opacity-disabled` (measured on the live rows: class '...data-[disabled]:cursor-not-allowed data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-disabled...'). No host renders a disabled preview row today.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — the specimen inherits row-level state styling it should be isolated from, exactly the isolation the canon already mandates for the WatercolorDot face (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4.2: 'WatercolorDot face delta is 0').
defects.reproduction: NONE — this is a labelled HYPOTHESIS. Trigger: add `disabled` to any preset/harmony SelectItem in GenerateControls.vue or AuroraPane.vue.
defects.proposedCure: The D-1 well opts the specimen out of row-level opacity; disabled is then expressed on the label and the well's frame, never on the colour.

defects.defect: The honest-absence arm is unreachable and therefore unproven. `v-if="stops.length >= 1"` never evaluates false in either host — generatePalette(count>=1,...) always returns >=1 entry and resolveCalibratedAtmosphere(...).palette is never empty — and the O-14 e2e honest-absence leg exercises the RAMP on /mix, not the strip. The strip's absence policy exists only in prose.
defects.evidence: PreviewStrip.vue:40; useColorGeneration.ts count ref min bound is the slider's :min="1"; aurora-harmony-stops.ts maps a non-empty resolved palette; e2e/smoke/oracles/o14-preview-truth.spec.ts:334-344 asserts `listbox [data-stops] count === 0` on the Mix Color-space menu (the ramp), never on a strip host.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — a declared law with no reachable arm and no gate, so it can neither be relied on nor falsified.
defects.reproduction: NONE — established by enumeration of the two producers plus the e2e route.
defects.proposedCure: Either delete the unreachable guard (the hosts guarantee non-empty) or, if the shared root of D-8 keeps it, give it a reachable producer and an oracle. A law with no arm is dead weight.

defects.defect: The chip of the currently-selected row is pixel-identical to the nine that are not; the specimen declines a selection-register job it is well placed to carry.
defects.evidence: Measured: gen-light Vibrant row data-state='checked' data-highlighted=true, atmo Analogous row aria-selected='true' — in both cases the chip's computed geometry, ring and segment paint are identical to the unchecked rows (probes-D/model-contrast.log, all rows report the same boxShadow/rect/ratio). The only marker is the producer's gutter dot.
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — one channel (colour) doing one job. Defensible under PROPORTION-AUDIT §5.14 (exactly one marker), but recorded because the specimen could be that marker.
defects.reproduction: NONE required — open either menu and compare the checked row's chip with any other.
defects.proposedCure: Optional: let the D-1 well carry the selected state on its frame (a nonzero monochrome and forced-colors delta, per VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4.2), so the specimen reads as 'the palette you have' without adding a second marker.

defects.defect: A fixed px radius on an em-scaled plate: --radius-sm resolves to 4px, which is 28.6% of the plate height at 14px and 21.9% at 18.3px, so the corner character is not scale-invariant. At the segment cap the two end segments lose ~7% of their painted area to the corner arcs while interior segments lose none, so the grammar's promised 'equal hard segments' are optically unequal at the ends.
defects.evidence: Measured borderRadius '4px' on .preview-strip at every viewport, against measured heights 14.000 / 14.719 / 16.391 / 18.297 px (probes-D/ratio-sweep.log). Arithmetic: corner area removed = (1 - pi/4) * 4^2 * 2 = 6.87 px^2 of a 5.984 x 16.391 = 98.0 px^2 end segment. Source PreviewStrip.vue:61.
defects.mechanism: F-beta — the same mixed-unit mechanism as D-3, expressed in the corner rather than the aspect.
defects.reproduction: Derived arithmetic over the E-1 measurements; visible in frames-D/D1-gen-light-pastel-6x.png where the peach stop's left boundary is a quarter-round.
defects.proposedCure: Scale the radius with the plate (`border-radius: calc(1em * var(--radius-plate-ratio))`) inside the shared root of D-8, so the corner is a proportion rather than a constant.

result.strongestDefect: D-1 — the colour specimen is invisible against the surface it is a specimen on, and the F8 inset ring named as the cure for exactly that failure measures fainter than the failure. Rendered-pixel evidence: every /atmosphere light-mode harmony strip's terminal stop at 1.011-1.124 : 1; the whole /generate Pastel chip at 1.011-1.345 : 1; the ring itself at 1.228-1.748 : 1. 22 of 24 chips carry a stop below the 3:1 non-text floor. A preview component whose entire purpose is truthful colour is, measurably, not showing the colour.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so this is not a negative-proof verdict — but the following were attacked and found SOUND, and are recorded in the report so a later seat does not re-litigate them. (1) MOTION: `grep -nE "transition|animation|@keyframes|will-change|transform" demo/color-session/color-chips/PreviewStrip.vue` returns nothing (exit 1). Nothing animates, so nothing forces layout and prefers-reduced-motion needs no arm; owner edict 6 is not engaged because no animation was ever present or removed (`git log --oneline -- demo/color-session/color-chips/PreviewStrip.vue` = one commit, a61094e3, a tree move). A tokenized cross-fade here would be a regression — a half-faded colour specimen is a lying colour specimen. (2) Vue 3.5 idiom (edict 7): `const { stops } = defineProps<...>()` at :27-30 is correct reactive props destructure; no template ref and no defineModel, so useTemplateRef and the shallowRef caveat do not apply. (3) verbatimModuleSyntax (edict 8): both imports at :21-22 are value imports; no type-only import to mis-declare. (4) God modules (edict 1): 76 lines, one job, one export; the barrel exports four symbols. (5) Legacy/compat (edict 2): no aliases, shims, dual paths or masking fallbacks. (6) The aria-hidden attribute itself is correct on /generate, where the row carries a name and a text description — it is the /atmosphere composition that is wrong (D-6), not the attribute. (7) Row overflow: `flex: none` on the plate plus min-w-0 on the host wrapper truncates the description and never the specimen; measured overflowX = 0 at 320px. Correct priority. (8) Idle cost: the SelectContent unmounts when closed, so the chips cost nothing at rest, and no pageErrors were raised on /generate by any probe.
